headline: Trump's 'Complete' US-Iran Peace Deal Nets Prediction Market Trader Over $1 Million In A Day
summary: Trump says the U.S.-Iran peace deal is complete. One Polymarket whale just made over $1 million on it, but hasn't cashed in yet.

headline: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq 100 Rallies, Oil Sinks 5% As U.S.-Iran Deal Reopens Hormuz
summary: Wall Street rallied Monday as a U.S.-Iran peace deal reopened the Strait of Hormuz, sinking crude 5%, pulling yields to one-month lows and lifting tech.
